claim: SATSentinel-X can reconstruct and analyze real spacecraft telemetry
evidence: ESA Mission-1 reconstruction, metadata, labels and selected-channel forensic outputs
limitation: Only 26 of 76 metadata channels reconstructed in workspace
allowed_paper_wording: We reconstructed and analyzed real ESA Mission-1 telemetry and event metadata.
disallowed_overclaim: Complete operational telemetry ingestion is already demonstrated.

claim: Class-3 anomalies exhibit measurable multivariate telemetry signatures
evidence: 30 Class-3 forensic population; channel/event analysis; all are multivariate in available metadata
limitation: Only 30 labeled events and partial telemetry
allowed_paper_wording: The evaluated Class-3 events show measurable multivariate signatures across heterogeneous morphologies.
disallowed_overclaim: All Class-3 anomalies share one universal signature.

claim: Frozen Detector v1 detects all labeled Class-3 events in the evaluated population
evidence: Initial and broader evaluations both report recall 1.0 under all-detected rule
limitation: Small positive population; same established positives; recall is not operational validation
allowed_paper_wording: Frozen v1 detected all 30 evaluated Class-3 events under the primary rule.
disallowed_overclaim: v1 detects all future or operational Class-3 events.

claim: Frozen Detector v1 has high recall on the broader ESA evaluation
limitation: 30 positives; unlabelled controls; not independent nominal validation
allowed_paper_wording: v1 achieved high recall on the 30-event broader ESA evaluation population.

claim: Frozen Detector v1 has low false-positive rate
evidence: Broader primary FPR is 40/170 = 23.5%; prior 60-control FPR 36.7%
limitation: Controls are label-negative/unlabelled, not nominal; protocols differ
allowed_paper_wording: The broader evaluation produced a 23.5% false-positive rate against label-negative/unlabelled controls.
disallowed_overclaim: v1 has low FPR, high specificity in nominal operation, or is operationally safe.

claim: Strong detector evidence is highly discriminative
evidence: Secondary strong-only broader point: FPR 1.18%, recall 96.67%; ROC/PR separation high
limitation: Not an independently optimized threshold; must not replace primary result
allowed_paper_wording: At a pre-existing strong-evidence operating point, discrimination was substantially better in this sample.
disallowed_overclaim: The strong point is optimal, validated, or deployment-ready.

evidence: Full v2: FP unchanged at 22 and one positive lost; high-dimensional bias remained
limitation: Controlled experiment is small and label-negative
allowed_paper_wording: v2 was evaluated as a separate experimental comparison and did not resolve observed failure modes.
disallowed_overclaim: v2 is the final or superior detector.

claim: OPSSAT demonstrates external generalization of v1
evidence: OPSSAT protocol report explicitly says direct frozen-v1 validation is false; robust_max ROC-AUC .4833
limitation: Different channels, fragments, semantics and protocol
allowed_paper_wording: OPSSAT provides an external protocol/domain-shift stress result, not direct v1 validation.
disallowed_overclaim: OPSSAT validates or proves generalization of v1.

evidence: Official dataset integrity, 2123 fragments/9 channels, protocol experiment ROC-AUC ~.483
limitation: Not a direct v1 semantic validation
allowed_paper_wording: The OPSSAT experiment exposed transferability and protocol limitations.
disallowed_overclaim: The result proves ESA detector failure on all spacecraft telemetry.

evidence: No Yamcs demonstration; readiness assessment only
limitation: Interfaces, replay, telemetry adaptation and operational acceptance remain
allowed_paper_wording: The research artifacts are being prepared for an operational demonstration.
disallowed_overclaim: The system is operationally validated or flight-ready.

evidence: No authorized v3; characterization and v2 results do not establish a validated redesign
limitation: Failure modes require prospective, nominally grounded study
allowed_paper_wording: No Detector v3 is authorized by the current evidence.
disallowed_overclaim: A v3 is necessary or scientifically justified solely because v1 has false positives.
